_comment: Static ffmpeg/ffprobe built by this project (tools/ffmpeg-build, .github/workflows/ffmpeg-build.yml): GPL (libx264/x265, SVT-AV1, dav1d), never --enable-nonfree; each release publishes its source archives. sha256 maps are filled in when a release is published. devFallback = third-party static builds (eugeneware ffmpeg-static b6.1.1 = ffmpeg 6.0, which IS configured --enable-nonfree) used ONLY by the in-app dev setup while our release doesn't exist; the installer build never uses it and refuses nonfree binaries. DELETE this block once the ffmpeg-7.1.1-vb2 release is published and its sha256 map is filled in.
